title: H-P: does pstack /create-formal-verification-skill help fix implicit-state-machine bugs?
question: On one subsystem with three planted state-machine bugs, does the told arm (skill, prompt starts with /create-formal-verification-skill) fix more bugs than the none arm?

redactions: absolute path of the local pstack clone in the Source line replaced by <pstack-clone>/

verdict.label: hypothesis-contradicted
verdict.text: DECISION: H-P CONTRADICTED: told fixes fewer planted bugs (CI upper bound < 0)

notes: n = 8 per arm, Sonnet, 30 turns; pass means all three bugs fixed and the regression test green.
The grader scores fixes only; the skill's own product, a verification skill, is not graded.
2 of 8 told trials ended at the turn limit.
